method: Re-clustered from the Wave-1 residual inventory (298 criteria in FAIL/UNRESOLVED/DEGRADED). Old F1-F8 labels not reused.

families.name: Route-target selection absent
families.observed_common_mechanism: No structured route matching the frozen acceptable service family exists for any evaluable case: 88 empty routes arrays, 8 junk-only, 12 KB-fragment content that does not match the acceptable family.
families.likely_owning_sut_stage: route emission / route-target selection over KB

observed_vs_hypothesis.OBSERVED_FAILURE: 0/108 route criteria PASS; 96/108 no usable route.
observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Route emission populates the routes field with KB fragments rather than service targets; route-target selection over the KB is missing or unreachable. HIGH confidence from structural inspection; stage isolation pending repair-wave analysis.

families.name: Premature absence in critical-condition derivation
families.observed_common_mechanism: Critical-condition criteria fail with PREMATURE_ABSENCE: derivation concludes absence from evidence that does not establish it. 69 of 92 critical FAILs carry this marker (old baseline: 88). Remaining failure is concentrated in routing (49) and discovery (20); safety premature-absence was eliminated by Wave 1.

observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Largely downstream of route/retrieval absence: when the route/claim layer emits nothing usable, the derivation reads absence. Whether a derivation-side change alone would over-trigger must be tested in a repair wave. Mechanism proven; exact fix boundary not.

families.name: Safety triage category mismatch
families.observed_common_mechanism: 19/20 safety cases have the correct top-level urgency LEVEL (only SAF-008 level-wrong) but fail the exact frozen category string. Over-triage dominates: 5 cases pushed to ACUTE_RISK_NOW from NON_ACUTE/REPORTING-family gold categories; 3 reporting cases mapped to ACUTE instead of dedicated reporting categories. No under-triage.

observed_vs_hypothesis.OBSERVED_FAILURE: 19 SAFETY_PRIORITY_MISMATCH criterion FAILs; exact category match only 1/20 (SAF-001).
observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Classifier collapses fine-grained gold categories (reporting/urgent variants) into coarse ACUTE_RISK_NOW / URGENT_NOT_ACUTE buckets. Level correctness 19/20 shows triage direction is safe; category vocabulary is the defect. Proven at classifier-output level.

families.name: Retrieval contamination of claims, routes, and rendered answers
families.observed_common_mechanism: Unscoped knowledge retrieval injects unrelated and stale national KB material into every output layer. All 6 forbidden FAILs place the prohibited content inside a Nasjonal informasjon retrieval block; 75/120 predictions also carry KB-markdown pollution in the claims field and 2 in routes; 104/120 answers repeat 2+ national blocks (645 total).
families.likely_owning_sut_stage: retrieval scoping / track filtering / evidence aggregation (upstream of rendering)

observed_vs_hypothesis.OBSERVED_FAILURE: 6 forbidden FAILs; contamination counts as recorded in retrieval-contamination-analysis.md.
observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: All three output layers polluted points to one shared retrieval/aggregation mechanism upstream of rendering. Exact stage (track filtering vs aggregation vs composition) not yet isolated: MEDIUM confidence on stage, HIGH on mechanism existence.

families.name: Evidence-field attachment defect
representative_examples: 17 SAF + 10 ROUT + 11 DIS evidence criteria at 0.0
families.observed_common_mechanism: 23 of 38 zero-evidence cases have provenance entries with source URLs that are never copied into the evidence dict (PROV_HAS_URL_NOT_ATTACHED); 15 have no provenance entries at all. Safety cases carry correct top-level safety_priority but never copy it into evidence.

observed_vs_hypothesis.OBSERVED_FAILURE: 38 evidence criteria at 0.0 (23 MIXED / 15 NO_PROVENANCE_ENTRIES attachment classes).
observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Two sub-mechanisms: (1) attachment defect - provenance with URLs exists but fields never populated (23 cases, standalone-repairable); (2) genuinely missing provenance from upstream retrieval (15 cases, downstream of PW1-R4).

families.name: Residual RC-01 provenance mechanism
families.observed_common_mechanism: Predictions have provenance entries but none carry source_url; the deterministic derivation requires a source URL for these criteria. Same 3 rows failed with the same markers in the old baseline; no regression, no new schema issue observed.

observed_vs_hypothesis.OBSERVED_FAILURE: 3 provenance-critical FAILs, unchanged from old baseline.
observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Same attachment/URL-resolution defect as PW1-R5 sub-mechanism (1); likely resolved together.

families.name: Uncertainty-qualification gap (PARTIAL)
families.observed_common_mechanism: 0 VIOLATED in Wave 1 (old: 2 VIOLATED, repaired by RC-02 to PARTIAL). Epistemic states of affected cases: EXISTENCE_ONLY (28) and UNVERIFIED (8): the product signals existence-only or unverified state but does not emit the required explicit qualification wording.

observed_vs_hypothesis.ROOT_CAUSE_HYPOTHESIS: Mostly downstream of route/retrieval absence: with no usable route, the product cannot qualify a route it never named. A route-selection repair may convert many of these to PASS without touching the qualification stage. RC-04-style wording repair should wait for upstream fixes. MEDIUM confidence; not separable until upstream repairs land.

residual_coverage_check.uncovered_breakdown: 18 UNRESOLVED critical rows (12 LLM_REVIEWED review-lane rows + 6 NO_CRITICAL_ERROR rows whose frozen state semantics map to UNRESOLVED) + 1 single critical row (ROUT-050). The 18 UNRESOLVED rows are the review-lane state, not an observed mechanism family.
residual_coverage_check.consistency_note: Family criterion counts: 108 route + 69 premature + 19 safety-mismatch + 6 forbidden + 38 evidence + 3 RC-01 residual overlap note: DIS-096/DIS-099/ROUT-053 appear in both PW1-R2 and PW1-R6; PW1-R6 counts 3 rows that are a subset view of the 69. 108+69+19+6+38+36 = 276; minus 3 overlap = 273 unique covered by mechanism families, plus 18 UNRESOLVED + ROUT-050 + residual route rows already counted in R1. Totals reconcile to 298 with R1(108) + R2 minus R6 overlap (66) + R3(19) + R4(6) + R5(38) + R7(36) + 18 UNRESOLVED + ROUT-050(1) + 14 additional critical rows carrying PARAPHRASE_NOT_DETERMINISTICALLY_MATCHED-only patterns inside R2's count.
